What does this change and why?

- [ ] I added or updated tests, including the suites in `test_utils/` if it can be reached over the wire
- [ ] `mvn verify` passes locally
- [ ] The README or `docs/` is updated if the behavior changed
- [ ] `docs/protocol.md` is updated if it adds or changes an operation, a request or reply field, or an error code
- [ ] `docs/operations.md` is updated if it adds a configuration key, a metric or a startup log line
- [ ] `docs/simplejs.md` is updated if it touches the JavaScript engine or anything scriptable
- [ ] `docs/clustering.md` is updated if it touches how nodes join, own, replicate, route or run transactions and scripts
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]` if a user of the server would notice the change
